Same page shell as model-benchmarking, so the same conditional rewards banner sits above the iframe and moves the top boundary by ~36px whenever a Buzz bonus is running; the pinned boxes in .claude/skills/app-capture/tests/fixtures/manifest.json were shot with it ABSENT, which is why 182 has always looked correct here. _measuredGeometry._why: the LIVE reading this rect was chosen against, machine-readable so gate P18 can check the rect fits it and cross-check it against the prose in `_measured`. The live lower bound is 1255-64=1191; the rect ends at 104+0+1050=1154, 37px inside it.

crop._measured: 2026-09-04, banner ABSENT, viewport 1709x1255, app-frame top=104, bottom gap=64 (read off the run's own probe answer APPFRAME_RECT:104,64,-1,1709,1255,0, taken by capture.sh immediately after the capture so the pair is matched). 🔴 WHY DECLARED AT ALL: the app is a FIXED-WIDTH 971px column, and detection refuses it with `full_frame` at 53.4% x 100.0% — full on the HEIGHT axis, which a declared rect is allowed to be (that check is an AND across axes while the detection gate is an OR). x=344 w=1003 puts ~16px of breathing room each side of the column at 360..1331 and excludes the iframe's own 16px scrollbar at 1692..1708 — a column-activity scan returns those as TWO runs, and taking the first and last active column instead of the runs pulls the scrollbar in and carries dead margin. y=0 starts at the iframe's top edge: this app's header carries no operator-specific chrome (unlike sensei's buzz chip) and it names the app, so it is kept. h=1050 ends at abs 1154 and was chosen to land in the GAP below the Storybook Illustration card so no row is half-cut. Verified by eye. 🔴 WHY NOT THE HORIZONTAL ANCHOR, MEASURED AT TWO WIDTHS RATHER THAN ARGUED: this app is a max-width container capped near 1825, and that cap is ABOVE the window widths actually in use. At a 3431px window the frame is 1825 wide with 803px of page each side, so the anchored form applies; at 1709 the frame IS the viewport (left inset 0, right gap -1) and the anchor degenerates to the absolute form while making `frame_of_record` refuse on almost every re-tile. The column itself is 971px at BOTH widths. So the anchor is not wrong here, it is useless here, and this rect uses the same yFrom-only form as every other declared recipe.
